Like other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the system of conditional relations to combined matrices of the Abhidhamma, specifically treating the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) alongside the triad of visible states (*sanidassanattika*) [SuttaCentral]. The text is not directly discussed or quoted in the provided secondary literature.
